provenance.source: JPL Horizons at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch; nominal published pole with arbitrary fixed phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed Kowal–Mrkos Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose. A smooth approximation of the published proportions, sized from infrared observations. The grid marks missing surface imagery. Rotation phase is illustrative.
